comment: Dr Park is amazing! She's very kind and is generous with grading. There is only two papers and a presentation for the class. The concepts she teaches are complex but she makes it very understandable. I definitely recommend taking her classes.
Brilliant teacher. Inspired me to major in the social sciences.

Dr. Park was a great professor! Very lecture heavy, but they were pretty interesting and I enjoyed them for the most part. Readings were definitely the worst part of the class, but she explained them well, and I found myself well prepared by skimming. She's extremely knowledgable and a very generous grader. She genuinely wants you to succeed!

Dr. Park is a great professor, and she grades very kindly. In this course, there was a short midterm paper and a longer final, as well as two presentations. Readings are not necessary, but certainly help. Classes are mostly in a guided discussion format, which is well-mediated by Dr. Park.
